full_prompt_en: A monochrome comic illustration shows a rugged, horned man seated in a carved chair, reading an open book across his lap. The figure dominates the center and right of the square composition. His sharply modeled face turns slightly left, with short horns projecting from his brow, swept-back dark hair, heavy brows, and a narrow pipe stem at his mouth. A light long coat with wide lapels and visible buttons falls over dark clothing, its folds described by fine hatched shadows. One hand holds the book near the lower center, while the other is raised beside a small smoking bowl or pipe. Loose smoke coils upward in pale grey ribbons across the white upper field. The chair's dark curved armrest and ornate scrollwork frame the lower right, giving weight to the seated pose. Behind the figure on the left, thin architectural outlines suggest pointed towers and a domed roof, receding into almost untouched paper. An old round clock sits in the upper-right background within a textured wall panel. Strong dark lines define the face, hands, clothing creases, and carved chair; lighter sketch lines and delicate crosshatching preserve the background's airy distance. The lighting is high-key and broadly even, with local shadows tucked into folds, hair, and recesses rather than a single dramatic cast shadow. A narrow black border contains the image. The result blends pulp-noir character drama with precise, layered black-and-white drawing.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅单色漫画插画描绘一位长着短角、面容粗犷的男子坐在雕花椅中，阅读摊在膝上的书。人物占据方形构图的中央与右侧。明暗塑形鲜明的脸略向左转，短角从眉额处伸出，深发向后梳，眉骨厚重，一根细烟斗嘴从唇边伸出。带宽翻领与可见纽扣的浅色长外套罩在深衣之上，细排线阴影描出衣褶。一只手在下方中央托着书，另一只手举在一只冒烟的小斗状器物旁。松散烟雾以浅灰丝带般的曲线向上盘绕，掠过上方白色区域。椅子深色弯曲扶手与华丽卷饰框住右下方，为坐姿增加重量。人物左后方，纤细的建筑轮廓暗示尖塔与圆顶屋顶，退入几乎留白的纸面。右上方背景的纹理墙面中有一面旧圆钟。强劲深线条定义面部、手、衣褶与雕椅；较浅的草图线和细交叉排线保留背景轻盈的距离。照明高调而大体均匀，局部阴影藏在衣褶、头发与凹处，而非一道戏剧性投影。窄黑边框围住图像。整幅画把通俗黑色风格的人物戏剧感与精确、分层的黑白绘画融合。
style_prompt_en: The illustration uses assertive monochrome comic linework, with thick contour accents, fine interior hatching, and pale exploratory construction lines. Dense blacks gather in selected recesses, while large reserves of white paper keep the overall value range open and high-key. Closely modeled focal forms contrast with airy, lightly drafted distance. Smoke-like curves, ornate small marks, and angular structural lines create multiple drawing rhythms without breaking the central hierarchy. Shading is local and tactile, built from short parallel strokes and crosshatching rather than smooth gradients. The result has graphic-noir intensity inside a precise, slightly sketchy printed-panel finish.
style_prompt_zh: 插画采用果断的单色漫画线条，粗轮廓强调线、细密内部排线和浅淡探索性草稿线并存。浓黑聚集在选定凹处，大面积保留的白纸则让整体明度开放而高调。紧密塑形的焦点与轻盈、草绘式的远处形成反差。烟雾般曲线、繁复小记号与棱角结构线构成多种绘画节奏，却不破坏中心层级。阴影局部而可触，由短平行线与交叉排线构建，而非平滑渐变。最终效果在精确而略带草图感的印刷画格质地中保有图形黑色风格的强度。
theme_en: A horned, rugged man in a long coat reads in an ornate chair with smoke curling overhead, rendered as detailed monochrome comic line art.
theme_zh: 一位长着短角、面容粗犷的男子穿长外套坐在华丽椅中读书，烟雾在头顶盘旋，以细密单色漫画线稿呈现。
name: Phil Hester
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
